title_es: Limitación de Velocidad y Configuración CORS
body_es: La limitación de velocidad (rate limiting) previene abuso controlando cuántas solicitudes acepta la API por cliente en un período. CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) controla qué dominios pueden acceder a la API desde navegadores web. En FastAPI, CORS se configura con CORSMiddleware especificando allowed_origins, allowed_methods, y allowed_headers. Rate limiting se implementa con librerías como slowapi. Configurar correctamente ambas características es crítico para seguridad y disponibilidad de la API.
body_en: Rate limiting prevents abuse by controlling how many requests the API accepts per client per period. CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) controls which domains can access the API from web browsers. In FastAPI, CORS is configured with CORSMiddleware specifying allowed_origins, allowed_methods, and allowed_headers. Rate limiting is implemented with libraries like slowapi. Properly configuring both features is critical for API security and availability.
example_output:
GET /public from https://example.com
→ 200 {"message": "Public endpoint"}
header: X-RateLimit-Limit: 100/minute
header: X-RateLimit-Remaining: 99

After 100 requests in 1 minute:
→ 429 {"detail": "Rate limit exceeded. Try again later."}

POST /login from unapproved origin
→ CORS error in browser console
